why_this_one: The Dark Lord's Dark Master set (docs/plans/dark-lord-gear.md batch 4; OpenMU's rows, drop 89-117, lords only). The user, 2026-10-25: 'we need missing Dark lord items', 'make missing peices'.
sheet_from: MuMain/src/bin/Data/Player, decoded with pipeline/decode_texture.py under MU's own names, lower-cased: navy scale traced in gold; KSup2 the cut-out mail.
material_note: painted_steel with the cast grain for the plate, the shading painted on, as the Dark Lord's other sets.
material_overrides_note: painted_steel's own grain is a blade's, brushed along V; on plate it drew vertical streaks (studio, 2026-10-04). plate_steel's cast grain instead, shallow for the gloss, as the other sets.
effects_note: MuMain has no render arm for MODEL_DARK_MASTER_* (no glow, no chrome pass, no sprite; docs/plans/dark-lord-gear.md). Its refine colour is PartObjectColor 15, (0.2, 0.3, 0.6) (ZzzObject.cpp:6739-6765, 6788-6818; src/game/shine.cpp); its full set the generic aura (fx/set_shine).
